confidence_notes: Restaurant and drink anchors rest on several sources that roughly agree, but most are undated, mix currencies, or come from a third-party copy of Numbeo, so they are medium confidence. Accommodation is weaker: the dorm and private hostel figures blend a Brazil-wide average with one Leblon listing calendar whose per-bed basis is unclear, and the 3-star figure is a Hopper monthly average for Copacabana. Cocktail and wine are derived from the local beer price, because the only direct cocktail data is a caipirinha price. Sources disagree on the three-course two-person meal: one Numbeo-style table implies about $21, while European-guide-derived figures imply about $36 to $40, so I set it near the upper-middle and treat it as uncertain. The FX value comes from a search snippet describing the RBA exchange rates overview for 15 Oct 2026. I did not verify it against the F11.1 table, and the 16 Oct third-party figure was not used.
comparable_city_reasoning: Rio de Janeiro treated as a large Brazilian tourism metro. Restaurant and drink anchors are cross-checked against Brazil-level cost-of-living tables and Rio-specific listings. Accommodation is based on Copacabana and Leblon samples and Brazil-wide hostel averages, with July low-season weighting for hotels.
